info.title: Xtab API
info.description: REST API of Xtab: workspaces, bases, tables, fields, views, records, imports and exports, members and their roles.

servers.description: Relative to the address of the installation

post.summary:
Log in: a session cookie `__Host-xtab_session`. Every failure — wrong password, unknown
or inactive account — gets the same answer in the same time.

200.description: Logged in; the session cookie is set

post.summary: End the session; the browser drops its cache and storage (`Clear-Site-Data`).

204.description: Logged out; the cookie is removed

post.summary:
Confirm the person of the session again with the password: for
ten minutes the session may do what needs it, e.g. export more than 1000 records. A wrong
password keeps the session; attempts count in the limits of login.
Set the first password of an invited account and log in.

422.description: validation-failed: token-invalid or a rule of the password

post.summary:
Request a letter with a reset link. Always `202`, at once: whether the account exists
is not revealed.

202.description: Accepted; a letter is sent if the account may get one

post.summary: Set a new password; every session of the account is revoked.

422.description: validation-failed: token-invalid or a rule of the password

get.summary: The account of the session.

patch.summary: Change the settings of one's own account: the language of the interface.

422.description: validation-failed: a language the interface does not speak

get.summary:
The matrix of rights of this version, generated from the code: the rights this build
enforces, without the ones still planned; readable by everyone who is logged in — the
rules of access are not a secret. The texts are in the language of the user.
Workspaces the user has a role in, or a role in one of their bases, with those bases.

post.summary: Create a workspace; its creator becomes its owner. Any active user may.

get.summary: A workspace with all its bases; needs a role in the workspace itself.

delete.summary: Delete a workspace with its bases (owner); the data stays until the trash removes it (v1).

post.summary:
Create a base (creator of the workspace): `202` with the operation that creates its
schema; the base is in `object` of the operation once it succeeded.

get.summary: A base (reader of the base).

delete.summary: Delete a base (owner); the data stays until the trash removes it (v1).

get.summary:
State of a structure operation; visible to whoever may open its base, or see its
workspace while the base is being created.

post.summary:
Create a table (creator of the base): `202` with the operation; the table is in
`object` of the operation once it succeeded. Without `fields` it gets «Название».

get.summary: A table with its fields and shared views (reader of the base).

delete.summary:
Delete a table with its fields and views (creator of the base); the data stays until
the trash removes it (v1).

patch.summary:
Rename or describe a table, or choose the field that names its records (creator of the
base).

422.description: validation-failed: name taken or invalid, description too long, a primary field of another table or of a type that names no record

post.summary:
Add a field at the end of a table or before or after one of its fields (creator of the
base): `202` with the operation; the field is in `object` of the operation once it
succeeded.

422.description: validation-failed: name, type, description, options, before or after

delete.summary: Delete a field (creator of the base); the primary field cannot be deleted.

patch.summary:
Rename, describe or change the settings of a field (creator of the base). Choices of a
single or multiple select are the whole list: known ones by `id`, new ones without it.

202.description: Accepted: a new formula is checked and counted in the background; `Location` is the operation

post.summary:
Create a shared view of a table (creator of the base); `grid` in v0.2. With `from`, the
new view copies the settings of that view of the same table.

get.summary: A shared view (reader of the base).

delete.summary: Delete a shared view (creator of the base); a table keeps at least one.

422.description: validation-failed: the last view of the table

patch.summary:
Rename a shared view or replace its settings (creator of the base): the order, widths and
visibility of the columns and the height of the rows.

422.description: validation-failed: the name or the settings

post.summary:
Invite a person. Without `workspace` and `base` — an administrator of the organization
only; with one of them — whoever manages its members, with a role by the rules of
granting. An active member is not invited again: give a role with `…/grants`.

201.description: Invited; the link went by mail (see `delivery`)

403.description: forbidden: not an administrator, or the role is above what the inviter may give

get.summary: Members of the organization; every member sees them.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: `usr_…` of the last member of the previous page.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: A part of the name or of the e-mail, regardless of case; at most 200 characters.

parameters.name: active
parameters.description: `true` — only active members: those a field of users may take.

200.description: A page of members by number

get.summary: Personal roles on a workspace; every member of it sees them.

post.summary:
Give or change a role on a workspace: not above the giver's own; a creator gives up to
«Editor» and does not touch creators and owners; the last owner stays.

delete.summary: Take away a role on a workspace; anyone may take away their own, except the last owner.

get.summary: Personal roles on a base (not those it inherits from its workspace).

post.summary: Give or change a role on a base, by the same rules as on a workspace.

delete.summary: Take away a role on a base; anyone may take away their own, except the last owner.

get.summary:
Records of a table in the order of a view (reader of the base): its filter and sort,
another sort by `sort=`; a page and the cursor of the next one.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: `viw_…` of the table: its filter and sort.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated `fld_…` or names of the fields to return; all by default.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description:
Comma-separated `fld_…` or names of the fields to sort by instead of the view's sort;
`-` before one sorts it from the largest. Up to five.

parameters.name: position
parameters.description:
Number of a record in the order of the view, from 0: the page starts at it instead
of a cursor; not together with `cursor`.

404.description: not-found: the table or the view

422.description: validation-failed: limit, fields, sort or cursor; view-too-heavy

post.summary: Create records at the end of the table (editor of the base).

patch.summary:
Change fields of records (editor of the base). With `if` a record changes only if the
fields still have the expected values; otherwise nothing is applied and the answer is
`412` with the current records.

post.summary:
Records of a table by a filter (reader of the base): `GET …/records` with the filter in
the body, joined by «and» with the filter of the view.

404.description: not-found: the table or the view

422.description: validation-failed: the filter (with the path to the condition), sort, limit, fields or cursor; view-too-heavy

post.summary:
The number of records of a query (reader of the base): the filter of the body joined
with the filter of the view by «and»; without a view — the filter alone, as a temporary
filter of a tab counts. Exact within 2 s, otherwise the estimate of the
planner with `exact: false`.

404.description: not-found: the table or the view

422.description: validation-failed: the filter, with the path to the condition

post.summary:
The headers of the groups of records with their summaries (reader of the base):
the groups and summaries of the view or of the request, the filter of the body joined
with the view's by «and»; without groups — the summary row of all the records. Exact
within 2 s, otherwise the estimate of the planner for the count with `exact: false`,
without summaries and groups.

404.description: not-found: the table or the view

422.description: validation-failed: the filter, groups or summaries, with the path to the part at fault

get.summary: One record (reader of the base).

post.summary:
A formula computed on one record before it is saved (reader of the base): the editor of a
formula shows the value of one with a function only the server computes.

200.description: The value of the formula on the record

404.description: not-found: the table or the record

422.description: validation-failed: the formula, with what is wrong and where

get.summary:
The number of records of a view with its filter (reader of the base): exact within 2 s,
otherwise the estimate of the planner with `exact: false`.

post.summary: Delete records for good — no trash in the MVP (editor of the base).

Search the records of a base (reader of the base): by word forms and the start of the
last word, else by fragment; up to 20 records of a table and 50 in all, the best first.

Export the records of a view to CSV or XLSX in the background. More than 1000 records
need `POST /auth/step-up` within ten minutes; the answer `202` is the export, followed by
`GET /exports/{export}`.

403.description: forbidden, or step-up-required for more than 1000 records

422.description: validation-failed: the separator, the filter, the sort or the search

get.summary: The state of an export; only the one who asked sees it.

The file of a finished export, as an attachment; only the one who asked downloads it,
within a day.

404.description: not-found: no such export, not finished, or its day is over

503.description: dependency-unavailable: the storage of files does not answer

post.summary:
Start an upload of a file: for an import, up to 50 MB; for a field of attachments, up to
the limit of the installation (100 MB by default), with the right to edit the records of
its table. The bytes follow by `PUT /uploads/{upload}`.

403.description: forbidden: no right to edit the records of the table

404.description: not-found: no such field or record

422.description: validation-failed: the name, the size or the field

429.description: too-many-uploads: four are on their way

put.summary:
The bytes of an upload (`application/octet-stream`). The type is found by the first
bytes: for an import CSV or XLSX, anything else is refused and not kept; for an
attachment any type, kept with the SHA-256 of the bytes. An attachment that sends nothing
for 30 seconds or less than 10 KB a second after a minute is dropped.

404.description: not-found: no such upload of this account, or it is done

408.description: request-timeout: the bytes stopped or came too slowly

503.description: too-many-uploads: the node takes no more uploads now; dependency-unavailable: no storage of files

get.summary:
A file of attachments: raster images, video and audio are shown by the browser, anything
else is downloaded; a script in a file never runs. One range of bytes may be asked for
(`Range: bytes=…`); `If-None-Match` with the tag of the bytes answers `304`.

206.description: The range of bytes asked for

304.description: The file is the one the browser has

404.description: not-found: no such file, or its field is gone

416.description: range-not-satisfiable: the range is beyond the file

429.description: too-many-downloads: eight are on their way, or the node is busy

503.description: dependency-unavailable: the storage of files does not answer

get.summary:
A thumbnail of an image of attachments: 64, 256 or 1024 px on its longer side, a JPEG or,
for an image with transparency, a PNG. Made in the background after the upload: until
then, and for files that are no images, `404`; 1024 px only of an image larger than that.

304.description: The file is the one the browser has

404.description: not-found: no such file or size, or the thumbnail is not made

429.description: too-many-downloads: eight are on their way, or the node is busy

503.description: dependency-unavailable: the storage of files does not answer

post.summary:
Import an uploaded file into a new table of the base: the file is analyzed in the
background, `GET /imports/{import}` shows what was found and the mapping proposed.

Import an uploaded file as new records of the table: as
`POST /bases/{base}/imports`, with the right to import into an existing table.

get.summary:
An import: the file as it was read, its first rows and the mapping; only its author
sees it.

patch.summary:
Change the mapping of an analyzed import: the name of the new table, its fields and types,
or the fields of the existing table each column fills. Another sheet or row of headers
reads the file again (`202`).

409.description: not-ready: the import is not analyzed or already runs

post.summary:
Run an analyzed import: its records are written in portions in the background, a new table
shows in its base when they are. More than a tenth of the first 1000 rows' values that do
not fit stop it (`paused`) until it is run again with `confirm`. Two imports of an
organization run at once at most.

403.description: forbidden: the right to import is gone

409.description: not-ready: the import is not analyzed, or runs already

post.summary:
Stop an import: what is written into an existing table stays and may be undone; an
import into a new table leaves no table.

Delete the records an import made, within a day after it; records
changed since stay unless `keep_changed` is `false`. Records it did not make are never
touched.

409.description: cannot-undo: nothing written, already undone, the table is gone, or the day is over

get.summary:
The report of the values of an import that did not fit: CSV with the row, the column, the
value and why; only the author of the import downloads it.

404.description: not-found: no such import or no report

AcceptBody.description:
Accept an invitation: the token from the link (in the body only), the first
password, optionally the name.

token.description: Token from the fragment of the invitation link.

schema_version.description: Grows with every change of the structure; a client compares it with its copy.

tables.description: Its tables with their fields and shared views.

BaseFound.description: The records found in a base, the best first.

records.description: Up to 20 records of a table and 50 in all.

indexing.description:
`tbl_…` of the tables whose search is still being filled: some of their records
may be missing.

more_tables.description: The base has more tables than one search looks in (the first 100 in their order).

BaseSearch.description:
A search of the records of a base: every table the reader sees, by word forms and by the
start of the last word; a table where no word is found is searched by fragment.

text.description: The text: up to 200 characters; of its words the first 8 are searched.

Change.description: A change of one record: only the fields sent are set; `null` empties a field.

if.description: Apply only if these fields still have these values; `null` — empty.

ChoiceInput.description: A choice of a single or multiple select. Without `id` it is a new one.

id.description: `opt_…` of an existing choice; absent for a new one.

name.description: Name, unique in the field regardless of case.

ChoiceOut.description: A choice of a single or multiple select.

field.description: `fld_…` or the name of a single select.

rules.description: Up to ten rules, in their order.

oneOf.description: `{"field"}`: the colour of the choice of a single select.
`{"rules": [...]}`: the colour of the first rule a record meets.

ColorInput.description: The colour of records as the API carries it: by a single select, or by rules.

ColorRuleInput.description: A rule of a colour: records of the filter get the colour.

filter.description: The filter, as of a view.

ColumnMapping.description: Where a column of the file goes.

source.description: The number of the column in the file, from 0.

field.description: Into an existing table: the `fld_…` it fills; none — the column is not imported.

name.description: Into a new table: the name of its field.

type.description: Into a new table: the type of its field.

skip.description: Into a new table: the column is not imported.

field.description: The field of the condition, by `fld_…` or name as the request gave it.
`fld_…` or the name of the field.

value.description:
The value: by the type of the field and the operator; absent or `null` — the
condition is being filled in and does not filter yet.

Count.description: The number of records of a view.

exact.description: `false` — the estimate of the planner: the exact count did not fit its time.

Delivery.description: How an invitation reached the person.

Direction.description: The direction of a key of a sort; empty values are last either way.

file_name.description: The name of the file, when it is ready.

expires_at.description: The file is downloaded by `GET /exports/{export}/file` until this moment, RFC 3339.

type.description: Type; new types may come — a client must accept them.

primary.description: The primary field of the table.

read_only.description: The system writes its values (autonumber, system fields).

FieldError.description: One problem of a field (an item of `errors[]`).

field.description: Name or path of the field in the request, e.g. `records[3].fields.Сумма`.

name.description: Name, unique in the table regardless of case.

before.description:
Put the field before this one (`fld_…`) in the order of the table;
without `before` and `after` it goes to the end. Only when adding one field.

after.description: Put the field after this one (`fld_…`); not together with `before`.

FieldPatch.description: Changes of a field; what is absent stays. Its type is not changed in v0.1.

oneOf.description: At least one node must hold.

FilterInput.description: A node of a filter as the API carries it.

FormulaPreview.description:
A formula computed on one record before it is saved: the editor of a formula shows the
value of one with a function only the server computes.

formula.description: The text of the formula, its fields by name in braces.

FormulaResult.description:
The type of the result of a formula: of its column and of its values. The server sets it
from the check of the formula; it is never the user's.

FormulaValue.description:
The value of a formula on a record, as a record carries the value of a formula field: a
number, a date, a moment, a flag, texts, or `{"error": "DIV_ZERO"}`.

primary.description: The primary field as text, with what was found in it.

field.description:
`fld_…` of the other field where the text was found, when it was not found in the
primary field.

oneOf.description: The piece of that field around what was found.

Fragment.description: A piece of text and what was found in it.

text.description: The text; `…` where it is cut.

hits.description:
What was found: `[start, end)` in characters (Unicode scalar values) of `text`,
in order, never overlapping.

GrantInput.description: A role to give or change.

GrantOut.description: A personal role on a workspace or a base.

level.description: 1 — the first level of groups, up to 3; 0 — all the records.

values.description:
The values of the group and of the groups it is in, from the first level, in the
forms of the values of records; `null` — empty. A date and time is grouped by its
day in the time zone of the organization, a text by its first 128 characters, a link
by the names of its linked records, `[{"name": …}]`.

summaries.description:
Summaries by `fld_…` or name: counts and numbers as numbers, percents with one
decimal place, dates as text; `null` — nothing to sum up.

Groups.description: The headers of groups and the summary of all the records.

total.description: All the records: level 0, no values.

groups.description:
Headers of groups of every level, each before the groups inside it, in the order of
the groups; at most 2000.

exact.description:
`false` — the query did not fit its time: `total.count` is the estimate of the
planner, there are no summaries and no groups.

truncated.description: More groups than an answer holds: the last ones are left out.

table.description: `tbl_…` of the table, when there is one.

oneOf.description: The file as it was read.
The mapping: proposed by the analysis, changed by the author.

records_rejected.description: Values that did not fit: their cells stay empty, the report lists them.

created_at.description: When it was asked for, RFC 3339.

rejected.description: The first values that did not fit: why the import stopped, or what its report holds.

report.description: The report of every value that did not fit: `GET /imports/{import}/report`.

undo_until.description: Until when its records may be deleted by `POST /imports/{import}/undo`, RFC 3339.

type.description:
The type guessed by its first 1000 values: `single_line_text`, `long_text`, `number`,
`date`, `date_time`, `checkbox`, `single_select`.

ImportMapping.description: The choice of the author (`PATCH /imports/{import}`); the analysis proposes one.

sheet.description: The sheet of XLSX; another one reads the file again.

header.description: The first row is the row of headers; a change reads the file again.

table_name.description: The name of the new table.

columns.description: The columns, in the order of the fields of a new table.

ImportSource.description: The file as the analysis read it.

InvitationInput.description:
An invitation: into the organization (administrator) or straight into a workspace or a
base with a role (who manages its members).

role.description:
`reader`, `commenter`, `editor`, `creator` or `owner`; required with a workspace or
a base.

InvitationOut.description: The result of an invitation; the link itself goes only by mail.

delivery.description: `mail`, `failed` (try again) or `off` (the console issues the link).

Me.description: The account behind a session, as the interface shows it.

locale.description:
The language of the interface the person chose: `ru` or `en`; none — the one of the
browser.

org_locale.description: The language of the organization (`ru-RU`): the words its formulas write in dates.

org_timezone.description:
The time zone of the organization (`Europe/Moscow`): the dates of its formulas count
in it.

MeChange.description: A change of the settings of one's own account (`PATCH /me`).

locale.description: The language of the interface: `ru`, `en`, or `null` for the one of the browser.

NameBody.description: A name of a new or renamed object.

name.description: 1 to 200 characters; spaces around it are dropped.

NewExport.description:
An export of a view (`POST /views/{view}/exports`): its records and visible fields, in
its order; a filter, a sort and a search of the tab instead of the view's, as the grid
reads them.

separator.description: The separator of CSV: `;` (Excel in Russian, numbers with a decimal comma) or `,`.

oneOf.description: A filter of the tab joined with the view's by «and».

sort.description: A sort of the tab instead of the view's.

NewImport.description:
An import of an uploaded file (`POST /bases/{base}/imports` into a new table,
`POST /tables/{table}/imports` into an existing one).

file.description: `fil_…` of a file the one who asks uploaded for an import.

NewRecord.description: A new record: values by field id or name.

before.description:
`rec_…` of the same table: the records go right before it in the manual order, one
after another. Without `before` and `after` — at the end.

after.description: `rec_…` of the same table: the records go right after it; not with `before`.

NewUpload.description: An upload asked for (`POST /uploads`): the bytes follow by `PUT /uploads/{upload}`.

field.description: `fld_…` of the field of attachments the file is for: required for an attachment.

record.description: `rec_…` of the record whose cell the file is for, when the record exists already.

Operation.description: A structure operation carried out in the background.

object.description: Public id of the created object, once it succeeded.

error.description: Code of the error of a failed operation, e.g. `forbidden`.

OptionsInput.description:
Settings of a field: `precision` of a number, an amount or a percent (0–8), `currency`
of an amount, `duration_format` of a duration, `max` of a rating, `choices` of a single
or multiple select — the whole list in its order; a choice left out is removed.

precision.description: Decimal places of a number, an amount or a percent.

currency.description:
ISO 4217 code of the currency of an amount: `RUB` (default), `USD`, `EUR`, `CNY`,
`KZT`, `BYN`, `UZS`, `AMD`, `KGS`, `AZN`, `GEL`, `TRY`, `AED`, `INR`, `GBP`, `JPY`.

choices.description: Choices of a single or multiple select.

table.description:
The table of the same base a link links to (`tbl_…`); given when the field is
added, not changed after.

single.description: A link to one record at most (many by default).

formula.description:
The text of the formula of a formula field, e.g. `{Price} * {Quantity}`; checked
against the fields of the table. Of a rollup — its expression over `values`, the
values of the linked records: `SUM(values)`.

link_field.description:
The link field of the same table a lookup, a count or a rollup reads through
(`fld_…`); given when the field is added, not changed after.

lookup_field.description:
The field of the linked table a lookup shows or a rollup sums up (`fld_…`): a rollup
takes numbers and texts; given when the field is added, not changed after.

condition.description:
The linked records a rollup sums up: a filter over the fields of the linked table, as
the filter of a view; none — all of them. Given when the field is added.

precision.description: Decimal places of a number, an amount or a percent.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the currency of an amount.

choices.description: Choices of a single or multiple select.

table.description: The table a link links to (`tbl_…`).

inverse_field.description:
The inverse field of a link in the linked table (`fld_…`); none for a link of a table
with itself.

single.description: A link to one record at most.

formula.description:
The text of the formula of a formula field, its references by the current names of
their fields: a formula reads a field whatever its name.

oneOf.description:
The type of the values of a formula field or a rollup: `number`, `text`, `flag`,
`date`, `date_time` or `texts` (a list of texts); of a lookup — of each of its values.

link_field.description: The link field a lookup, a count or a rollup reads through (`fld_…`).

lookup_field.description: The field of the linked table a lookup shows or a rollup sums up (`fld_…`).

condition.description: The linked records a rollup sums up, as the filter of a view; none — all of them.

data.description: Records in the order of the view.

next_cursor.description: Give it as `cursor` for the next page; absent on the last one.

PermissionRow.description: A row: an action checked by role, or a right that comes from elsewhere.

action.description: Stable name of the action (`record.write`); absent for rights from elsewhere.

min_role.description: The lowest role that may do it.

scope.description: `workspace` or `base`: where the role is taken from.

by.description: What the right depends on, for rights from elsewhere.

Permissions.description: The matrix «role × action» of the installed version.

roles.description: Roles from the lowest to the highest; each includes the rights of the previous one.

sections.description: Sections of the matrix in the order of the documentation.

notes.description: Footnotes; `notes` of the actions refer to them by number from 1.

PreconditionFailed.description: The answer `412 precondition-failed` of a write with `if`: nothing was applied.

errors.description: The fields whose values differ, by record.

current.description: The records of `errors` as they are now.

Problem.description: Body of an error response: RFC 9457 problem details with the problem types of the API.

fields.description: Values of the fields; an empty one is `null`.

color.description: Its colour by the colour of the view; absent — none.

more.description:
Links beyond those a cell of a link field carries, by the key of the field: how many
more there are; absent — the cells carry them all.

RecordCount.description:
A count of records (`POST /tables/{table}/records/count`): the filter joined with the
filter of the view by «and»; without a view — the filter alone.

oneOf.description: The filter, as in a query of records.

search.description:
A search: records whose shown text, long text, choice or primary field holds it,
regardless of case and of `ё`; up to 200 characters.

RecordGroups.description:
Groups of records and their summaries (`POST /tables/{table}/records/groups`):
the filter joined with the filter of the view by «and»; groups and summaries instead of
the view's when given. Without groups — the summary row of the whole view.

view.description: `viw_…` of the table: its filter, groups and summaries.

oneOf.description: The filter, as in a query of records.

groups.description: Groups instead of the view's, up to three levels.

search.description:
A search: records whose shown text, long text, choice or primary field holds it,
regardless of case and of `ё`; up to 200 characters.

RecordQuery.description:
A query of records (`POST /tables/{table}/records/query`): `GET …/records` with a filter
in the body, joined by «and» with the filter of the view.

view.description: `viw_…` of the table: its filter and sort.

fields.description: `fld_…` or names of the fields to return; all by default.

oneOf.description: The filter, up to 100 conditions and three levels of groups.

sort.description: The sort instead of the view's, up to five keys.

position.description: Number of a record in the order, from 0: the page starts at it instead of a cursor.

groups.description:
Groups instead of the view's, up to three levels (a temporary grouping). Records of
a grouped view come in the order of the headers of its groups, then of the sort.

group.description:
The records of one group: its values, one per level of the groups, from the first;
`null` — the group of empty values.

oneOf.description: The colour instead of the view's (a temporary colour).

search.description:
A search: records whose shown text, long text, choice or primary field holds it,
regardless of case and of `ё`; up to 200 characters.

records.description: In the order of the request.

RejectedValue.description: A value of the file that did not fit its field: its cell stays empty.

row.description: The row of the file, from 1, the row of headers counted.

ResetBody.description: Set a new password by a reset link.

token.description: Token from the fragment of the reset link.

RowHeight.description: Height of the rows of a grid.

confirm.description: Write even though more than a tenth of the values checked do not fit.

SortInput.description: A key of a sort as the API carries it.

field.description: `fld_…` or the name of the field.

StepUpBody.description:
Confirm the person again before a sensitive action: the password
of the account of the session.

SummaryInput.description: A summary of a field as the API carries it.

field.description: `fld_…` or the name of the field.

function.description:
`empty`, `filled`, `unique`, `percent_empty`, `percent_filled`; for numbers also
`sum`, `average`, `min`, `max`; for dates `earliest`, `latest`, `range`; for a flag
only `checked` and `unchecked`.

Table.description: A table with its fields and shared views.

manage_views.description:
Whether the one who asks may change its shared views (creator of the base); others
filter and sort for themselves only.

TableInput.description: A new table; without `fields` it gets the primary field «Название».

name.description: Name, unique in the base regardless of case.

fields.description: Its fields; the first one is primary.

TablePatch.description: Changes of a table; what is absent stays.

primary_field.description:
The field that names the records from now on, `fld_…`: a field of the table of a type
that may name them — a text, a number, a date, a choice, an autonumber, a formula.

keep_changed.description: Keep the records changed since the import; `true` by default.

UploadPurpose.description: What a file is uploaded for.

content_type.description: Its type by its first bytes: for an import `text/csv` or the type of XLSX.

width.description: Pixels across of an image, as it is shown.

height.description: Pixels down of an image, as it is shown.

next.description: Give it as `after` for the next page; absent on the last one.

ViewColumn.description: A column of a view: its field, its width and whether it is hidden.

width.description: Width in CSS pixels, 60…600; without it — 180.

hidden.description: Hidden in this view; the primary field never is.

ViewConfig.description:
The settings of a grid view: the order, widths and visibility
of its columns, the height of its rows, its filter, its sort, its groups, the summaries of
its fields and the colour of its records.

columns.description: Columns in their order; fields not listed follow in the order of the table.

sorts.description: The order of the records, up to five keys; none — the manual order.

groups.description: Groups of the records, up to three levels; within a group the sort applies.

summaries.description: Summaries of fields under their columns and in the headers of groups.

from.description: A view of the same table (`viw_…`) whose settings the new one copies: «duplicate».

ViewPatch.description: A change of a view: its name, its settings, or both.

oneOf.description: New settings, whole: they replace the old ones.

Workspace.description: A workspace with the bases the user may open.

bases.description: Its bases visible to the user, by name.

session.name: __Host-xtab_session
session.description: Session of the browser; changing requests also carry `X-Xtab-Request: 1`

tags.name: imports
tags.description: Uploads of files and imports of CSV and XLSX

tags.name: members
tags.description: Members of the organization and their roles

tags.name: structure
tags.description: Workspaces, bases, tables, fields, views and operations on the structure
